name: Get Wasos file
info:
Fetches a single file from the WaSOS API and stores the buffer in global context.

### Input
- msg.payload — single file object with .url, .name, .type, .size
- msg.metadata — standard metadata (needs source.client_specific.api.key)
- msg._dl — download context (message_id, connection_name for building context key)
- msg.parts — join parts for reassembly

### Logic
1. Build download request — constructs HTTP GET to WaSOS file endpoint
2. GET file from WaSOS — HTTP request, returns binary buffer
3. Store file via global context — on success: generates context key, stores buffer via global.set("files.<key>"). On failure: logs warning.

### Output
- msg.payload — file result: { name, type, size, downloaded, context_key? }
- msg.parts — preserved for join node
- msg._dl — preserved for merge node
